description: Keep local AWS session and execution-plan state from an MCP client: start and end sessions, set region and profile, list the curated AWS regions, and create and advance step-by-step plans, all in an in-memory store with no AWS calls. A clean-room, renamed rebuild of the AWS core MCP server's session and plan meta core. One bin serves the CLI and a stdio MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/cloudsession
